patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background treatments (solid colors, gradients, or subtle patterns) contain content centered within a consistent max-width container.
Key brand elements and offers (e.g., 'DN88', '+200%') utilize extremely large, bold, and often gradient-filled or outlined display typography for maximum impact.
A high-contrast primary color palette of vibrant blue, bright yellow, and strong red is consistently used for backgrounds, accents, and call-to-action elements.
No scroll-triggered motion or animations are observed; the design relies on static visual hierarchy and bold graphics to convey information.
Repeated content blocks feature a prominent image (often a person or game graphic) paired with a concise text description, arranged in a grid or stacked layout.

technique_notes: Hero sections are designed with a large, illustrative background image that extends full-width, overlaid with oversized, bold, and often gradient-filled text to highlight key offers and brand identity.

Content sections are built as full-width containers with varied background styles (solid colors, subtle pixelated patterns, or gradients) to visually separate information blocks, with all textual content constrained to a central, fixed-width column.
Call-to-action buttons feature a strong, solid color fill (yellow or red) with contrasting white text, using subtle rounded corners to soften their appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, heavy display headings (~5-6x body) with gradient or outline effects, contrasted with standard-sized body text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and some image cards, providing a slightly softer edge without being fully rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to dense overall, with the hero section being more airy due to large graphics and text, while content sections maintain a consistent vertical rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, bold, and often gradient-filled display typography in the hero section, combined with a high-contrast primary color palette, creates an immediate and impactful visual statement that is far from subtle.
